name: fastcrud-deterministic-conditional-read-revisions
instr:
Give FastCRUD callers stable validators for materialized reads so direct CRUD operations and generated HTTP routes can perform conditional reads consistently. Equal observable results must share a validator regardless of internal representation, while changed results must invalidate it without altering established response shapes or customization behavior.

Revision tokens are deterministic for nulls, supported scalars, mappings, sequences, UUIDs, dates, datetimes, decimals, and Pydantic values, with equivalent dictionary and model representations producing equal tokens without changing returned representations or existing validation failures. Model revisions cover every mapped primary-key field in mapper order, and revisions describe final materialized results after null cleanup, composite-identity deduplication, sorting, and limits. Collection revisions cover the ordered returned collection and configured response key; empty item and collection results have stable, distinct meanings. RevisionConfig selects item, collection, or page meaning, including whether pagination metadata affects the token, while preserving pagination envelopes. A matching known token raises RevisionNotModified with the current token for every direct read path; stale tokens return the complete current result and ResultRevision. Revision-enabled generated GET routes use that same token as ETag and translate any matching If-None-Match value into a bodyless 304 without response-model serialization. Witho
